integrity: The exact moment identities are analytic consequences of the Skellam mass function, a telescoping Bessel recurrence, and Poisson score differentiation. Finite numerical checks are supplementary only.
scientific_limitations: Specific to two iid Poisson variables with equal intensity. The publicly accessible comparison to the 2015 Poisson Gini-mean-difference paper was limited to its abstract, so overlap risk remains for the intermediate mean-absolute-difference formula; no source located covered the variance identities or Fano asymptotics.
title: Exact moments and the universal Fano limit for two-sample Poisson extremes
